image: Water comes again and again: Pit after pit.
So the noble one holds virtue and conduct constant
lines: down into a pit inside the pit.
Down into the pit inside the pit.
A jar of wine, two vessels of grain —
the simple gift passed in at the window.

notes.name_en: 坎 is a pit, hole, trap in the ground; rejecting Wilhelm's 'The Abysmal'. Revised pilot: 凶 now 'Misfortune.', Image pivot 'So…'.
notes.L3: 險且枕 kept literal — peril for a pillow, resting your head on danger.
notes.L4: 簋 ritual grain vessels; 約 the frugal/simple gift; 牖 a window-opening.
